verdict.rationale: Codegen is itself a coding-agent platform, so it sits in the MCP client role. The evidence shows it consuming MCP: it can "integrate any MCP-compatible server", "provision MCP servers across your org", and inject Codegen integrations into Claude Code via MCP. None of this shows Codegen running as an official MCP server, such as a documented serve command or a hosted MCP endpoint, so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
